snippet.title: Burdenfall – First look Trailer (Dark Fantasy Roguelike Deckbuilder)
snippet.description:
Burdenfall is a narrative roguelike deckbuilder about personal growth and inner struggle. Climb the ever-shifting castle and uncover the truth behind the Weeping Crown’s message.

Wishlist Burdenfall on Steam:
